meta.scope: Indonesia Batch 1 — Foundational statistical system and core macro/demographic nodes. Opens the country under the locked expanded definition (own-cadence series + static + recurring-citation instruments). Focuses on BPS as the central statistical authority, the flagship yearbook, population census architecture, and the first layer of national accounts, prices, labour and poverty.
meta.strategy_note: Phase 0/1 opening for Indonesia. National statistical office = BPS (Badan Pusat Statistik). Central bank = Bank Indonesia. Archipelagic geography and extreme provincial heterogeneity will require later regional densification (Java vs outer islands).

candidates.title: BPS – Statistics Indonesia (Badan Pusat Statistik)
candidates.description: The national statistical office of Indonesia. Responsible for censuses, surveys, and the large majority of official socio-economic statistics. Publishes an extensive catalogue of recurring series and the annual Statistical Yearbook of Indonesia.
referenced_by: All major BPS statistical programmes and the Statistical Yearbook
National planning documents (RPJMN) and policy analysis that cite official data
candidates.notes: Institutional core node. Every subsequent BPS series will reference this authority.

candidates.title: Statistical Yearbook of Indonesia (Statistik Indonesia)
candidates.description: Flagship annual compendium presenting geographic, demographic, social and economic statistics drawn from BPS and other agencies. Provides national and provincial comparisons and technical notes. Continuously cited as the single-volume overview of official Indonesian statistics.
referenced_by: Policy documents, academic work and international reports that need a comprehensive official snapshot
Provincial statistical yearbooks that mirror its structure
candidates.notes: Highest-visibility recurring BPS product. Functions as the ‘one-stop’ official statistical reference.

candidates.title: Population Census (Sensus Penduduk) and Long Form results
candidates.description: Decennial population census (most recent full cycle SP2020 with short-form enumeration and subsequent Long Form survey). Produces the definitive population stock, fertility, mortality, migration and related demographic parameters used throughout the statistical system.
referenced_by: Labour-force, education, health and poverty surveys that use census frames
National Medium-Term Development Plan (RPJMN) population targets
candidates.notes: Foundational demographic node. The Long Form SP2020 results are the current high-detail source for fertility, mortality and migration.

candidates.title: National Accounts / GDP statistics (PDB)
candidates.description: Quarterly and annual national accounts (Produk Domestik Bruto) by expenditure and by industrial origin, at current and constant prices. Provincial GDP (PDRB) series exist and will be densified later.
referenced_by: Bank Indonesia Economic Report on Indonesia
candidates.notes: Core macro node. Provincial PDRB will form the main spatial economic layer in later batches.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index (Indeks Harga Konsumen – IHK)
candidates.description: Monthly Consumer Price Index and inflation rates. Compiled for a set of cities and aggregated to national urban inflation. Primary inflation indicator used by Bank Indonesia and the government.
referenced_by: Bank Indonesia monetary-policy decisions and reports
Poverty line calculations and real-income analysis
candidates.notes: High-frequency price node. Directly linked to monetary policy and poverty measurement.

candidates.title: National Labour Force Survey (Sakernas)
candidates.description: Periodic labour-force survey producing employment, unemployment, underemployment, labour-force participation and informal-sector indicators. Principal official source for labour-market statistics.
referenced_by: Bank Indonesia and fiscal assessments of the real economy
candidates.notes: Core labour node. Critical for understanding the large informal sector and youth employment challenges.

candidates.title: Poverty statistics (official poverty line and incidence)
candidates.description: Official poverty measurement using the basic-needs poverty line (food + non-food). Published at national and provincial level, with urban/rural splits. Continuously cited in RPJMN targets and social-protection design.
candidates.notes: High-policy-visibility social node. Provincial poverty rates will be important for later regional densification.

candidates.title: National Socio-Economic Survey (Susenas)
candidates.description: Large-scale household survey that is the primary source for consumption, expenditure, poverty calculation, education, health and many SDG indicators. Conducted in multiple modules and rounds.
candidates.notes: Foundational household microdata node that underpins poverty, inequality and many social statistics.

candidates.title: Bank Indonesia – central bank statistical and policy publications
candidates.description: Central bank of Indonesia. Publishes monetary statistics, balance of payments, financial-system statistics (SSKI), the Economic Report on Indonesia (LPI), Financial Stability Review, and multiple surveys (business, banking, property).
candidates.notes: Second institutional pillar alongside BPS. Will generate multiple detailed series in subsequent batches.

candidates.title: Economic Report on Indonesia (Laporan Perekonomian Indonesia – LPI)
candidates.description: Bank Indonesia’s flagship annual economic report. Reviews domestic and external performance, monetary and financial developments, and policy outlook. Continuously cited as the authoritative central-bank narrative.
referenced_by: International assessments of the Indonesian economy
candidates.notes: High-authority annual narrative node from the central bank.

candidates.title: Indonesia Financial System Statistics (SSKI)
candidates.description: Monthly compilation of financial-system indicators covering banks, non-bank financial institutions, financial markets, payment systems, and related real-sector linkages. Core macroprudential data product.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and International Investment Position
candidates.description: Standard BPM-based balance-of-payments and IIP statistics. Key external-sector series for a commodity-exporting and capital-flow-sensitive economy.
